description: Drops a site's staged changes without touching the live site. Free.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

site_key.description: The site whose staged changes should be dropped. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

name: discard_staged
title: Drop staged changes
